Only the 16 key dwords +4 (0x828024 + k*8) are read; they are drawn from a small key set {1..12} plus 0, 0x10000 and 0xffffffff, and the spec draws eax mostly from {1..12}, so the first match lands at every position 0..15 and no match occurs in about a third of the cases.
